lines.text: You bring what you already have. A brief, a deck, or just a conversation.
I shape the message and write the script. You approve it before anything is designed.
Then a style frame and a scene plan. That's the second approval, before animation starts.
Then production: animation, editing, and audio or captions where agreed.
You review it, I revise within scope, and you get final files in the formats you need.
When something changes later, only the changed part gets updated. The style carries forward.
Two approvals before animation, so nothing is a surprise.
